source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For configured OAuth SMTP servers, Retry clears only the access token when module initialization succeeds, retaining refresh state for another attempt. Enter New Password follows password forgetting and conditionally clears access/refresh state plus covered stored logins. An empty host returns after clearing the cached password; failed OAuth initialization skips token clearing. Cancel exits the failure path. Accepted persisted-token removal is async and SMTP waits internally through its existing bridge. Removal is bounded by origin, username and scope coverage. Browser fixtures cover SMTP prompt choices, with EWS variants skipped. No live recovery was run.
title: SMTP OAuth prompt actions clear different token state
